title: A Very Cubic Christmas with the Un-Perimeter Cannon
description:
It's time for the Wavetech Secret Santa event and this year we are doing something big, as in hundreds of thousands of blocks big. In this video we will build a cannon to destroy the gigantic hole in Wavetechs nether dimension and thoroughly vindicate Yun, the recipient of our gift. But how do you destroy a hole you might ask? Well, if the creation of a hole means the removal of material, then its destruction must involve adding material. In this video we will design a TnT cannon capable of firing hundreds of thousands of concrete blocks at supersonic speeds to fill a massive void. However this task quickly turns out to be very complicated and things don't quite go according to plan. Get ready to find out how even the most experienced technical players can have their spirits destroyed by Minecraft and it's unpredictable behaviours.
